win_claim.quote: The algorithm significantly outperforms other oversampling baselines on most classifiers and assessment metrics.

uncertain: Bold/underline marks for supp Table 8 not recoverable from text; marks filled only for the 7 datasets of main Table 3 (p.7).

Binary datasets D1-D10 (supp Table 1 p.11) have no per-dataset results vs plain SMOTE; main Table 6 (p.10) compares only PA, SVDD(WSMOTE), F-SMOTE (AUC and GM, SVM). Source repo of binary sets not stated.
n_features left null (paper prints #Fn and #Fc separately; summing would be computing); values are in how_obtained_detail.
n_minority/n_majority for multi-class left null (no single minority/majority).
Main-text baseline is called SMOTE-all (round-robin); classifier for abstract highlight not stated, C5.0 chosen as first reported (main Table 3).
Main Table 3 prints Cleveland MC-RBO etc. with stray spacing artefacts in extraction; irrelevant to chosen columns.
notes: Main paper is multi-class/mixed-type; 20 KEEL datasets. Complete per-dataset results for 4 classifiers x 4 metrics (AvAcc, CBA, MG, CEN) are in supp Tables 6-21 (pp.23-30). Main Table 6 binary results (AUC, GM, SVM) on D1-D10 compare PA, SVDD, F-SMOTE, Proposed only. Other variants: none named. Supp Table 5 (p.16) is simulated-data SVM accuracy. EMDO comparison in supp Tables 23-26 (C4.5; Pmin, Pavg, AUCm, MAUC) on 6 benchmarks. Noise-added conditions not extracted.
